title: Cutline Chase
generation_prompt: This is a continuous excerpt from the MIDDLE of an already-playing full-volume chorus, not a song opening. The first beat and last beat both have complete drums, bass, chords and pitched hook at strong normal level. No gradual energy or volume ramp. Create one ORIGINAL 128-second stereo LIQUID DRUM AND BASS instrumental for an all-ages one-or-two-key rhythm game at STRICT constant 172 BPM in 4/4. A full, clean fast breakbeat starts at time zero: strong short kick on one and three, dry snare on two and four, crisp eighth hats, an extra clipped muted-key attack on every quarter beat and a separate syncopated rim accent. Preserve all audible attacks and the same loudness through 128 seconds, no beatless bridge. Signature hook: four clipped notes alternate between two close pitches and then leap to one held high answer. At 64 seconds keep drum grid and level, change bass roots, reverse the pitch alternation and answer with a different descending three-note phrase. No quiet intro, slow build, half-time switch, filtered outro, fade, silent tail, tempo drift, abrasive distortion, vocals, speech, samples, known melody or imitation of another song.
cover_prompt: Create one original SQUARE 1:1 duohertz cover for Cutline Chase, an all-ages drum & bass rhythm-game track. Original near-black editorial comic-print cut-paper style with warm ivory, electric cyan, coral red and sparse halftone. Keep every named motif element inside the central 55% width and y=25–68% of the square for a narrow 100px mobile crop, with dark lower fifth for the local title overlay. Flat graphic, no realistic scenery, people, text, letters, numbers, logo, watermark, strobe or copied game art. Main motif: Exactly TWO thick warm-ivory diagonal cut-paper strokes chase each other across a compact central square, each stroke interrupted by ONE squared gap; ONE thin electric-cyan zigzag beat line crosses between them, with exactly TWO coral rectangular ticks and one tiny yellow impact diamond at the meeting point. Abstract paper-cut rhythm, not blades, lightning bolts, arrows or roads.
og_prompt: Edit the supplied Cutline Chase square cover into a HORIZONTAL roughly 1.9:1 duohertz social card. Preserve two ivory gap-cut diagonal strokes, the single cyan crossing zigzag, two coral ticks and one yellow impact diamond. Recompose the complete motif on the RIGHT half over near-black comic-print ink with sparse halftone, leaving calm dark space on the LEFT. Add exactly two crisp fully legible English lines at left: 'duohertz' lowercase electric cyan and 'Cutline Chase' larger warm ivory. Spell both exactly, no truncation. Purpose-build the wide composition; do not stretch the square. No other text, scenery, people, logo, watermark or copied game art.
